topic: Identification of types of paint & Restoration of paint
syllabus_extract: Identification of types of paint & Restoration of paint i.e. nitro cellulose lacquer epoxy, fluorescent and enamel surface protection.
specific_objectives: 6.2.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand surface protection materials, paint identification, restoration of various paint and application, dope shop, dope articles and troubles.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Identification of paint samples (Nitro, Epoxy, Enamel, Fluorescent) and matching to restoration protocols; Safety: PPE usage, ventilation checks; Supervision: Instructor verifies sample identification accuracy.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of surface protection materials on an aircraft?
Name one common type of paint used for aircraft surface protection.
Why is proper paint identification critical before starting restoration work?

summary_questions: Explain the key difference between Nitro Cellulose Lacquer and Epoxy paints.
Describe the correct procedure for identifying paint types before restoration.
List three common troubles encountered during paint application and their solutions.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the specific restoration steps required for a damaged Nitro Cellulose Lacquer surface, referencing the procedures discussed in the next lesson plan (LP 12) regarding application methods.
